title: Dodgers call up Seth Halvorsen with Roki Sasaki on injured list

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: Dodgers call up Seth Halvorsen with Roki Sasaki on injured list
sources.description: The Dodgers lost Roki Sasaki to a blister on his right middle finger in the fourth inning on Wednesday night. On Thursday, Sasaki was placed on the 15-day injured list in favor of another reliever, with Seth Halvorsen recalled from Triple-A Oklahoma City. “It was a pretty good blister, it came out of nowhere.
